Real Madrid Secures Late Victory Over Elche in La Liga Match

Real Madrid secured a 3-2 victory against Elche in a La Liga match on Tuesday. The team took a two-goal lead through a Matias Dituro own goal and a strike from Kylian Mbappe. However, Elche mounted a comeback with second-half goals. Substitute Carlos Espi scored in stoppage time to clinch the win for Real Madrid. Kylian Mbappe also provided an assist in the match.
